title: Draft Prospects: top 10 WRs + RBs, who they play like / produce like
parts:
Our top 10 draft-eligible WRs and RBs on the Alpha Draft Signal (thru Week 11), with comps:

Plays like = closest PFF career profile
Throwback = closest pre-2014 box-score match
Produces like = closest production, rating and age match

They don't always agree 👇

WRs

#1 Jeremiah Smith (Ohio State) · plays like: Marvin Harrison Jr. · throwback: Dez Bryant · produces like: Elijah Moore

#2 KJ Duff (Rutgers) · plays like: Marcell Ateman · throwback: Alshon Jeffery · produces like: DeAndre Hopkins

#3 Mike Matthews (Tennessee) · plays like: Jalen Virgil · throwback: Allen Hurns · produces like: Josh Malone

#4 Wyatt Young (Oklahoma State) · plays like: Keke Coutee · throwback: Josh Huff · produces like: Allen Robinson

#5 Ryan Williams (Alabama) · plays like: Shae Wyatt · throwback: Cody Latimer · produces like: Deebo Samuel

#6 T.J. Moore (Clemson) · plays like: Anthony Nash · throwback: Taylor Price · produces like: Brennan Eagles

#7 Duce Robinson (Florida State) · plays like: Michael Jefferson · throwback: Jonathan Baldwin · produces like: Tyron Johnson

#8 Cam Coleman (Texas) · plays like: Adonai Mitchell · throwback: Brandon LaFell · produces like: Jerry Jeudy

Robinson: out for season (ACL).

#9 Ryan Wingo (Texas) · plays like: Jalen Virgil · throwback: Taylor Price · produces like: Jarvis Landry

#10 Nick Marsh (Indiana) · plays like: Tyrone Howell · throwback: Cody Latimer · produces like: Tyler Boyd

RBs

#1 J'Koby Williams (Texas Tech) · plays like: Joe Mixon · throwback: C.J. Spiller · produces like: Javonte Williams

#2 Jadan Baugh (Florida) · plays like: Tahj Brooks · throwback: Toby Gerhart · produces like: Trayveon Williams

#3 Wayshawn Parker (Utah) · plays like: Jarquez Hunter · throwback: C.J. Spiller · produces like: Tevin Coleman

#4 Justice Haynes (Georgia Tech) · plays like: Robert Henry Jr. · throwback: Mikel Leshoure · produces like: Ja'Quinden Jackson

#5 Isaac Brown (Louisville) · plays like: Bryce Love · throwback: Dri Archer · produces like: AJ Dillon

#6 CJ Baxter Jr. (Kentucky) · plays like: Brenden Brady · throwback: Matt Asiata · produces like: Sony Michel

#7 Kewan Lacy (Ole Miss) · plays like: Jalen White · throwback: Ryan Williams (Va. Tech) · produces like: Rex Burkhead

#8 DeSean Bishop (Tennessee) · plays like: Ronald Jones II · throwback: Mark Ingram · produces like: Kenjon Barner

Lacy: out for season (shoulder).

#9 Mark Fletcher Jr. (Miami) · plays like: Ja'Quinden Jackson · throwback: Stevan Ridley · produces like: Justin Jackson

#10 Antwan Raymond (Rutgers) · plays like: James Butler · throwback: Bishop Sankey · produces like: Clyde Edwards-Helaire

Production comps: matched on production, rating and age, not film.
Play-style comps: PFF career profiles (efficiency, depth, YAC, usage; WRs add drop rate, 1st downs/route, slot rate, size), not film.
Throwback = closest pre-2014 player on a box-score profile.

Pick one guy and tell me which comp you believe: the one he plays like, or the one he produces like.

When they disagree, I lean production. Tell me why I'm wrong.
